name: markman
description: Markman: Claude Code plugin for IP law. MCP servers, backend API, and local data store.

scripts.dev: node server.js & cd frontend && npx vite --port 5173
scripts.build:mcp: npx -y esbuild@0.24 mcp/uspto-server.js mcp/wipo-server.js mcp/markman-store.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --outdir=mcp/dist --out-extension:.js=.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
